info.title: Aura Realtime Stream
info.description:
Live market, dispute, and account events from Aura over Server-Sent Events.

One endpoint carries every topic. Pass a comma-separated `topics` query parameter and the server multiplexes them onto a single connection. Public topics need no session; `user:` topics require a session belonging to that wallet.

Reconnects are lossless within the retention window: send the last event id you processed as `Last-Event-ID` (or `?lastEventId=`) and the server replays what you missed. If you were away longer than retention allows, it sends a `replay-reset` instead of leaving a silent gap.

See the [Realtime data guide](https://docs.aura.markets/api-reference/realtime) for client patterns.

testnet.description: Testnet. Same API against test tokens.

realtimeStream.title: Realtime stream
realtimeStream.description: Server-Sent Events endpoint. Subscribe with `?topics=a,b,c`. Anonymous connections accept up to 8 topics, signed-in connections up to 20.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to topics
subscribe.summary: Open an SSE connection and receive events for the requested topics.
subscribe.description:
Public topics: `market:{address}:orders`, `market:{address}:fills`, `dispute:{marketId}`, `settings:banner`, `health:indexer`.

Session-scoped topics: `user:{address}:orders`, `user:{address}:fills`, `user:{address}:parlays`, `user:{address}:notifications`, `user:{address}:reveals:{marketId}`, `user:{address}:rewards:{marketId}`.

Requesting a `user:` topic for a wallet other than the authenticated one returns 403.

auraEvent.name: aura
auraEvent.title: Data event
auraEvent.summary: A row changed on a subscribed topic.
auraEvent.description: Delivered as SSE event type `aura` with the event id set to the monotonic `id` field. Treat unknown `entity` values and unrecognized `payload` fields as forward compatibility rather than errors.

examples.name: Trade executed
examples.summary: A fill on a market's yes book

examples.name: Order cancelled
examples.summary: A resting order removed from the book

auraReset.name: aura-reset
auraReset.title: Replay reset
auraReset.summary: Replay was not possible; refetch state from REST.
auraReset.description:
Sent when the requested `Last-Event-ID` falls outside the retention window. The server cannot guarantee you have seen every event since then, so it tells you explicitly instead of leaving a gap.

Handle it by refetching a snapshot for that topic from REST and resuming from live. Ignoring this message means running on stale state indefinitely.

auraError.name: aura-error
auraError.title: Stream error
auraError.summary: A mid-stream failure. The connection closes after this.
auraError.description: Reconnect without a cursor and refetch a snapshot.

topic.description: The topic the failure applies to, when scoped to one.

heartbeat.name: heartbeat
heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description:
Delivered as an SSE comment line, not an event: `: heartbeat 2026-07-29T19:12:19.402Z`. Standard `EventSource` clients ignore comments automatically. If you parse frames yourself, skip lines beginning with `:`.

Heartbeats keep intermediate proxies from closing an idle connection, and they double as a liveness signal: no frame of any kind for more than 30 seconds means the connection is dead even if the socket still looks open.

id.description: Monotonic event id. Persist the last one you applied and send it as `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect.

topic.description: The subscription that produced this event.

operation.description: What happened to the underlying row.

entity.description: The kind of record that changed. New entity types are added without a version bump.

payload.description: The changed fields. New fields are added without a version bump.

topic.description: The topic that could not be replayed.

afterEventId.description: The cursor you supplied, which was too old to serve.
